resources.string: LiteSkip uses the accessibility service to watch for "Skip / Agree / Close" buttons on screen and taps them for you, skipping splash ads and popups. It never reads your typed input; the app has no Internet permission and uploads nothing.
Auto-skip splash ads & popups · No Internet permission
Show a toast when a click lands
Global skip applies to all apps
No custom rules yet. Tap "Add" to create one, or use "Screen picker" to grab button labels straight from the target screen.
Nothing yet. Auto clicks will show up here.
Rules stay on this device only. Import/export goes through the system file picker — no storage permission needed.
For study and personal use only; comply with the laws of your region. The app has no Internet permission and uploads nothing; accessibility content is processed transiently in memory.

Tap "Start" and the app goes to the background with a 12-second countdown: switch to the target app and arrange the popup. When time is up the current screen is captured — come back to LiteSkip and tick the labels to build a rule.
Tick labels to use as keywords (package is locked to the captured app)
Excluded apps are not auto-skipped on splash screens
It stays in the background and taps "Skip / Agree / Close" buttons for you — splash ads, privacy dialogs and in-app popups. No Internet permission, nothing uploaded.
Required for everything. Tap below to jump to system settings, turn on "LiteSkip · Auto Skip Service", confirm the prompt — a check mark appears here when it is on.
Chinese ROMs kill background services; without these settings skipping stops after a while. On Xiaomi / HyperOS follow four steps to stay resident.

1. Settings → Apps → LiteSkip → Autostart: on
2. LiteSkip → Battery saver → No restrictions
3. Recents: long-press LiteSkip card → Lock
4. In accessibility settings enable the accessibility shortcut for quick re-enable after reboot
Open any app with a splash ad — "Splash ad skipped" means success. For uncovered popups, use "My rules → Screen picker" on the home screen to grab button labels and add a rule.
